title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight
description: Follow the adventures of Po, who partners up with a no-nonsense English knight named Wandering Blade to find a collection of four powerful weapons before a mysterious pair of weasels do, and save the world from destruction.

episodes.title: S3-E16A Teacup Filled with the Self

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 1x1
episodes_data.description: Po's popularity is gone after wicked weasels steal a powerful gauntlet. English knight Wandering Blade offers a chance to chase down the thieves.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 1x2
episodes_data.description: Po is ready and willing to be Blade's apprentice. But their mismatched personalities clash — until Po's masterful kung fu moves impress his partner.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 1x3
episodes_data.description: When Klaus and Veruca strike a hedgehog village for a scroll, Po must choose between helping a prisoner or keeping the trust of the elder monks.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 1x4
episodes_data.description: With the emperor's Forbidden Company on their tail, Po and Blade head to Po's favorite comic book creator to learn the location of the next weapon.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 1x5
episodes_data.description: A mysterious figure helps Po. Po and Blade must put aside their differences when they stumble into Klaus and Veruca in the desert spice market.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 1x6
episodes_data.description: Po and Blade follow the comic book's map and journey through the treacherous desert. The secretive stag makes a deal with Klaus and Veruca.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 1x7
episodes_data.description: The warriors meet the reclusive Rukhmini and try to convince her to hand over the fire whip. Colin the stag questions his alliance with the weasels.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 1x8
episodes_data.description: Veruca's magic powers are of no use, so she seeks to treat her injured brother in a secret forest village. But Po and Blade are right behind them.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 1x9
episodes_data.description: With Klaus and Veruca in tow, Po and Blade set their sights on England. The emperor meets Po's protective dad, Mr. Ping, and a scheming Rukhmini.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 1x10
episodes_data.description: The duo rushes to the emperor's palace to warn him of Klaus and Veruca's intentions. Po and Blade get separated, and a hidden secret is revealed.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 1x11
episodes_data.description: Blade explains everything about her past. An epic sled chase through the snow-covered mountains leads Po to make a fateful decision.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 2x1
episodes_data.description: Po and the gang arrive in India in search of Rukhmini's old friend Diya, who might be able to help them on their quest for the Tianshang weapons.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 2x2
episodes_data.description: The team will have to outsmart guards and guests to pull off a heist at Jayesh's engagement party. But someone present has other plans.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 2x3
episodes_data.description: In pursuit of the enchanted pendant, the crew crash Jayesh's wedding. Meanwhile, Veruca and Klaus meet the new Archmage and threaten to steal his helmet.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 2x4
episodes_data.description: When the pendant releases the spirit of an ancient master, Po will have to fight the one person he never thought he would.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 2x5
episodes_data.description: In the New World, the team helps defend a cacao farm against a hungry monster, which leads them to cross paths with the new owner of the Storm Wheels.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 2x6
episodes_data.description: The group travels to Tikal in search of the Protector, but the hero's identity remains a mystery. There's only one way to unmask them: a trap.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 2x7
episodes_data.description: To win an audience with Tikal's ruler, Team Dragon must compete in a heated pok-ta-pok tournament. But competition quickly brings out Blade's bad side.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 2x8
episodes_data.description: When Po and his friends scale a volcano to confront a mad scientist, Master Mastodon warns them they're treading on dangerous ground.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 2x9
episodes_data.description: Blade learns about her brother's past from an unexpected source. Later, the Tianshang weapons fall into the wrong hands.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 2x10
episodes_data.description: As the Dragon Knights prepare to battle for control of Tikal, Blade sets out to avenge her brother. Mastodon and Po connect over the Storm Powers.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 2x11
episodes_data.description: With their forces combined, the Dragon Knights head into a final showdown for the Tianshang weapons to save the city — and themselves. Skadoosh!

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 2x12
episodes_data.description: To keep the gang's spirits up on their voyage, Po tells the tale of a hunter who helped protect a village from a dragon on the first Lunar New Year.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x1
episodes_data.description: When Mr. Ping stands accused of breaking the Pirate's Code, Po must defend his father in Forouzan's court. But there's something Ping hasn't told his son.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x2
episodes_data.description: Po and his friends fight for their freedom in a Triple Tournament of Certain Doom, where the only rules are the ones Forouzan makes up as she goes along.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x3
episodes_data.description: Ping leads the team on a quest to recover the crate of Tianshang weapons from Forouzan's secret stash... without getting caught by Sir Drake's knights.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x4
episodes_data.description: Back in England, Blade insists on doing things her way by retracing Alfie's final days. The first stop? A chess tournament with the Queen of England.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x5
episodes_data.description: Blade vows to fight the bog monster that Alfie crossed paths with 15 years earlier. Whatever she finds may be the answer to her brother's disappearance.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x6
episodes_data.description: To continue following Alfie's path to the ancient city, the Dragon Knights search for his journal in a most hostile place: Blade's mother's house.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x7
episodes_data.description: While the Dragon Knights team up with a local jester to find a secret symbol, Ping guards the weapons crate with help from an unlikely ally.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x8
episodes_data.description: The Dragon Knights and their newest member navigate a strange and mysterious dimension. Veruca makes a startling discovery about her ancestors.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x9
episodes_data.description: The group splits up as Blade and Lucinda head home to reclaim Alfie's sword from Sir Drake, and the others meet Ping at the docks to receive the weapons.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x10
episodes_data.description: After the Queen calls off Sir Drake's mission, he swears to hunt down Blade and make her pay for her crimes against the knighthood — with her life.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x11
episodes_data.description: It's a race to the forge to destroy the Tianshang weapons before Veruca uses their power to unleash an ancient, deadly army — and destroy the world.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x12
episodes_data.description: With the Tianshang weapons in the possession of a new ruler, the Dragon Knights are forced to disband and return to what's left of their homelands.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x13
episodes_data.description: When Po gets discouraged and loses his enthusiasm for adventure, Blade puts on her thinking beard and plans a special mission to get him out of his funk.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x14
episodes_data.description: Po heads to Tikal to retrieve Akna while Blade travels to Raipur to find Rukhmini — but their long-lost friends may not be ready for a reunion.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x15
episodes_data.description: With the Dragon Knights reunited, their last hope of recapturing the weapons rests on the shoulders of the last person they'd expect. Off to Mage Island!

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x16
episodes_data.description: Po teaches Klaus that to unlock his powers, he must first look within. The rest of the team forages for food while Blade avoids Colin, who has a crush.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x17
episodes_data.description: The Dragon Knights travel to the Lost City so that Klaus can better connect his powers to the Ancient Masters, who have an important message for him.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x18
episodes_data.description: With the ancient army distracted by a fake war between China and England, the team attempts to steal back one of the Tianshang weapons.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight 3x19
episodes_data.description: The elements are in chaos. Pangea is collapsing. And it's up to Blade to battle the all-powerful weapon master and save the world — once and for all.
